name: ssh-remote-control-mcp
description: Remote SSH control MCP server based on the ssh-remote-control skill, exposing connection, execution, upload, and download tools over stdio.

scripts.build: esbuild index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js --minify --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'module'; import { fileURLToPath as __fileURLToPath } from 'url'; import { dirname as __dirnameFn } from 'path'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url); const __filename = __fileURLToPath(import.meta.url); const __dirname = __dirnameFn(__filename);" && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('public','dist/public',{recursive:true})"
